recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下被片狀原始細胞取代，核卵圓或有凹陷、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，其間夾雜深染小圓核的紅血球前驅細胞與含嗜酸性顆粒的骨髓細胞，並有核分裂像，屬 AML 的組織學表現；CEBPA 突變須靠分子檢測確認。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with oval, focally indented or folded nuclei
Finely dispersed vesicular chromatin with small but visible nucleoli
Moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Residual hematopoietic elements: small clusters of erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and scattered eosinophilic myelocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow largely replaced by sheets of medium-to-large blasts with oval to indented nuclei, fine vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, with scattered mitotic figures. Residual erythroid precursors and eosinophilic granulocytic cells are interspersed. Megakaryocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; subclassification as AML with CEBPA mutation depends on molecular testing, since the histology is not specific.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts are more monotonous with scant cytoplasm and lack admixed granulocytic differentiation, and are TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive and MPO negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with coarser chromatin and prominent nucleoli, express CD20/PAX5 and lack CD34/CD117/MPO.
MDS-IB shows <20% blasts with preserved dysplastic trilineage maturation, whereas blasts form sheets here (confirm by CD34 count and aspirate differential).
Monocytic blasts/promonocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and folded nuclei and express lysozyme, CD163 and CD14 rather than a granulocytic profile.
